title: Meredith College academic calendar
description: The `dates` global: one entry per year, one term per season, read by the kit to build the `term` and `lessons` data (the syllabus dates and the per-meeting lesson calendar). Source: the Meredith College Academic Calendar for the years covered.

LABELS.description: Display names for holidays, keyed by the holiday's (start) date.

^\\d{4}$.description: A calendar year, holding one term per season key.

deadlines.description: Registrar deadlines, keyed by name. `audience` says who the date is surfaced to — "students" entries appear in the syllabus Key Semester Dates list, "faculty" entries only on the instructor lesson pages.

preRegistration.description: The day pre-registration for the NEXT term opens; instructor-facing (a heads-up that advisees will come asking about the schedule).

substitutions.description: College-wide schedule-substitution days, mapping an ISO date to the weekday whose class schedule runs that day. Example: 2026-09-09 is a Wednesday, but the College runs Monday classes that day to make up the meeting lost to Labor Day — so a MWF section meets, a Tue/Thu section does not. The kit flags these on the lesson overview and per-day pages.

holidays.description: No-class days: a bare ISO date for a single day, or `{ start, end }` for a multi-day break (inclusive). Display names live in LABELS, keyed by the (start) date.

midTerm.description: The official mid-point of the term (progress-report cutoff), used when planning test placement.

readingDays.description: Study days between classes and exams — no classes or exams may be held.

finalExams.description: The College's examination window; each section's exact slot comes from the registrar and lives in the course data (`finalExam`).
